synopsis: Chapter 9 and the glossary identify VerifAI, alongside S-TaLiRo and Breach, as a falsification tool for seeking failures through parameter combinations [f6836, f16025, f7247]. The booklet places these tools within a broader family that includes Bayesian optimization, evolutionary search, fuzzing, surrogate-guided search, reinforcement-learning adversaries and Adaptive Stress Testing [f14148]. Chapter 9 specifically states that Scenic 3 integrates with VerifAI, while the glossary describes the Scenic–VerifAI integration without specifying a version [f7175, f16025]. On-road work from 2021 reported up to a fivefold speed-up for VerifAI with Scenic using parallel multi-objective falsification; the supplied facts do not establish that this gain transfers to heavy off-road validation [f6839, f14149].

relations.note: Glossary repeats the named tools and expands the surrounding falsification-method family.
Glossary explains failure seeking as searching parameter combinations where a function fails.
Both report the 2021 fivefold maximum speed-up from parallel objectives with Scenic.
Chapter specifies Scenic version 3 for the integration described in the glossary.
Glossary extends the listed methods with fuzzing, reinforcement-learning adversaries and Adaptive Stress Testing.
Program list adds Bayesian optimisation, surrogate-guided search and evolutionary search to the named tools.
Reported joint-tool performance provides an example of the Scenic–VerifAI integration.
